A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Clarity, before you click.

Can I use this for real customer bookings?

Use fictional data to explore the demo. The owner workspace supports private Firebase synchronization. Public customer booking, staff accounts, server-authoritative business validation, and business timezone settings are not ready for a broad production launch.

What happens to the appointments I create?

Local demo records stay in your browser. When you explicitly sign in to a cloud workspace, its records are stored privately in Firebase under your account and synchronize across your devices. Demo records are never uploaded automatically. Sign out on shared devices.

Does it send reminders or take payments?

No. The demo sends no SMS, email, or push notifications and processes no payments. Displayed service prices are sample prices.

What is the next engineering milestone?

Add staff and customer roles, enforce booking business rules on a trusted server, configure a consistent business timezone, and complete payment onboarding. Owner isolation and simultaneous booking transactions have emulator tests.
